sun.description: This site - my portfolio and hub for the whole ecosystem.
sun.detail:
This site is the hub for everything I build.

It's a custom `React` + `Vite` front end with my own component library and a private `Verdaccio` registry.

- Back end is a `Spring Boot` monolith with `Hibernate`, `Postgres` and `Redis`
- Deployed behind `Nginx` on a `VPS` with `Pi-hole` + `Nginx` at home for local routing.

guided-reader.description: App for learners of Modern Greek. Read at your level with community help.
guided-reader.detail:
App for learners of Modern Greek. Pick a text at your level, read with community annotations, and leave your own.

Built with the same `React` + `Vite` setup as Sun.

- Browse texts by level (A1-C2) with colour coding
- Highlight any range to create an annotation with comments, votes and private notes
- Dictionary lookup via `WordReference` and `Forvo` audio
- Sign in with `Discord` or a password, tested with `Cypress`/`Vitest` and running live alongside Sun

niece-scarlett.description: Discord bot, integrated with Guided Reader.
niece-scarlett.detail:
Discord bot, integrated with Guided Reader.

Listens for `niece scarlett` / `ns` and slash commands. Uses `Machine Learning` to grade texts by `CEFR` level and an intent-based command setup for natural phrasing.

- Nine commands: `classify`, `define`, `text`, `texts`, `annotations`, `pronounce`, `lt`, `help`, `reload`
- Understands natural phrasing with fuzzy matching and typo tolerance
- `define` uses `WordReference`, `pronounce` uses `Forvo`

learner.description: CLI that turns Wikipedia into scored quizzes.
learner.detail:
CLI that turns `Wikipedia` into a quiz you can actually learn from.

`npx sun-learn learn "Immanuel Kant" --questions 10` pulls the topic from `Wikipedia` and related internal sources, builds questions, and runs the quiz in your terminal.

- Types: multiple choice, fill in the blank and short answer
- Pulls data from `Sun` and `Wikimedia` and generates interactive quizzes
- Saves each run with what was researched, answers and gaps
- Stores results for spaced repetition and `Anki` deck generation

filestore.description: Front end for a self-hosted Garage instance.
filestore.detail:
Front end for a self-hosted `Garage` instance. Buckets and keys are browsed by prefix. Uploads go direct to storage via presigned `PUT`s, downloads via presigned `GET`s.

- Create, rename, delete and move keys and folders
- Viewers for images, video and PDF
- Torrent ingestion, paste a magnet or `.torrent` or search through `Jackett`

checklist.detail:
Frontend for a checklist service. `Items` are reusable tasks, `Templates` group them in order, `Entries` are dated checklists you work through.

- Create entries blank, from one template, or from several at once
- Each entry has a `Garage`-backed gallery for images
- Mark items complete, failed or not needed as you go
